1432-2645-3430-5873.easyPrerequisites: Ioreth of the Healing House doesn't have summoning sickness.
1432-2645-3430-5873.description:
Activate Everglades by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{B}{B}{B} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, untapping Everglades
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2577-4446-5670.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Cleric
Your life total is at least 2.
2577-4446-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Relic Vial triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

1753-4289-4770-6090.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

245-2034-6441.description:
Activate Marneus by paying {6}, creating four creature tokens due to Elspeth, Storm Slayer.
When the tokens enter, Marneus triggers, causing you to draw a card
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing three creature tokens, adding six {C}.
Repeat.

1479-2443-2841-3875.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Evolving Wilds.
1479-2443-2841-3875.description:
Fetch a land using Evolving Wilds.
When the fetched land enters, Tireless Provisioner and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Tireless Provisioner trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Tireless Provisioner triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1479-2841-4488-8102.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Windswept Heath.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-4488-8102.description:
Fetch a land using Windswept Heath.
When the fetched land enters, Rampaging Baloths and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Rampaging Baloths trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Rampaging Baloths from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Rampaging Baloths triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

728-3661-4053-6989.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Shield Sphere.
Cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

1349-2921-6854.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken creature with a coin counter on it.
1349-2921-6854.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature with a coin counter on it.
When the creature dies, Athreos's second ability and Host of the Hereafter's ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting a coin counter onto itself as well as +1/+1 counters if those were present.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Host of the Hereafter.
When Host of the Hereafter dies, it and Athreos's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting a coin counter and +1/+1 counters onto the other nontoken creature.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning Host of the Hereafter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 6.
Repeat.

1545-4399-4770-6626.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Wind Crystal.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Trostani trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Trostani trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1545-4399-4770-6626.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

7-3967-4907-6989.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures that each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
7-3967-4907-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Hamza. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

579-2366-4742-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
579-2366-4742-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}{G} due to Mana Reflection.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

224-4482-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
224-4482-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull is a creature and has at least two charge counters on it.
224-4482-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers twice, untapping Hearthhull and another creature you control.
Repeat.

997-1510-4574-5849.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Arcbound Stinger.
When Arcbound Stinger dies, its modular ability triggers, putting its +1/+1 counters on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Arcbound Stinger from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Arcbound Stinger from the top of your library by paying {0} due to Fortune Teller's Talent.
Repeat.

2-373-877.description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {0}.
When Ancestral Statue enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

147-997-2562.description:
Cast Graceful Reprieve by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Graceful Reprieve, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Graceful Reprieve.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, Graceful Reprieve triggers, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Woe Strider abilities from step 5.

2866-4211-4986-5256.description:
Cast Tormod's Crypt by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

141-2921-6933.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2921-6933.description:
Cast Incarnation Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Incarnation Technique.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Incarnation Technique, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Incarnation Technique copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2173-5220-5686-6538.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Fear of Lost Teeth.
When Fear of Lost Teeth dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fear of Lost Teeth from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Fear of Lost Teeth trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Cast Fear of Lost Teeth from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.

2173-4905-5220-6273.description:
Activate Fanatical Firebrand by tapping and sacrificing it.
When Fanatical Firebrand dies, Mortuary and Embalmed Ascendant trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fanatical Firebrand from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Fanatical Firebrand ability.
Cast Fanatical Firebrand from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

5315-6871-6879-6880.description:
Cast Stonework Puma by paying {3}.
When Stonework Puma enters, Haru triggers, targeting Stonework Puma as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Stonework Puma.
When Stonework Puma dies, Haru triggers, returning Stonework Puma from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Stonework Puma enters, Haru triggers, targeting Stonework Puma as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat from step 3.

869-1766-1987-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Thran Dynamo by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Thran Dynamo.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

3641-5670-6792--5.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
3641-5670-6792--5.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Repeat.

703-3470-5702.manaNeeded: {1} if the land card in hand does not enter untapped and/or cannot produce mana
703-3470-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand. 
You are able to play a land this turn.
703-3470-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko and Lotus Cobra trigger.
Holding priority, if the land enters the battlefield untapped, activate it by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Astral Dragon.
When the Astral Dragon token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two copies of a land you control that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
When the land tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Lotus Cobra trigger twice.
Resolve both Lotus Cobra triggers, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Repeat from step 4 with the second Springheart Nantuko trigger.

703-4050-4394-5929.description:
Cast Everquill Phoenix for its mutate cost by paying {3}{R}, mutating it over or under a non-Human creature you control.
Everquill Phoenix triggers, creating a Feather artifact token.
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two copies of the Feather token that are 3/3 Dragon creatures.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Astral Dragon, adding {1}.
Activate a Feather by paying {1} and sacrificing it, returning Astral Dragon from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-4359-6438.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4359-6438.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Elsha, triggering Breath of Fury and Elsha.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

4613-5475-6210.easyPrerequisites:
Neerdiv has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Neerdiv, Devious Diver does not have summoning sickness.
4613-5475-6210.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that does not have summoning sickness and that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4613-5475-6210.description:
Activate a creature using Forensic Researcher's ability by tapping it, untapping Neerdiv.
Activate Neerdiv using Forensic Researcher's ability by tapping it.
Neerdiv triggers, causing a player to mill cards equal to its power.
Resolve the Neerdiv ability from step 2, untapping another creature.
Repeat.

4826-5414-5720-5721.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
Lands you control and/or land cards in your graveyard that enter the battlefield untapped can tap to produce at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
4826-5414-5720-5721.description:
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland.
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Grist, Voracious Larva // Grist, the Plague Swarm

1887-3305-4022-5147-5926.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability triggers, returning Grist, Voracious Larva from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Grist, Voracious Larva enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to pay {G} to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Grist, the Plague Swarm with six loyalty counters due to Vorinclex.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Grist, the Plague Swarm's third loyalty ability by removing six loyalty counters from it.
Grist, the Plague Swarm is put into your graveyard as a state-based action due to having zero loyalty.
Resolve the Grist, the Plague Swarm ability, creating a token copy of each creature card in your graveyard that is a 1/1 Insect.
When the Grist, Voracious Larva and Hidden Herbalist tokens enter the battlefield, the Hidden Herbalist token triggers once and the Grist, Voracious Larva token triggers for each token created this way.
Resolve all Grist, Voracious Larva triggers, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the Hidden Herbalist trigger, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Grist, Voracious Larva token, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 1, sacrificing a Body Launderer token instead.

2721-2899-3983.description:
Cast Bloodline Necromancer by paying {4}{B}.
Bloodline Necromancer enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.
Bloodline Necromancer enters the battlefield, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1789-2232-3593-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a Dragon creature card in hand.
1789-2232-3593-5231.description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting any Dragon from your hand onto the battlefield.
The Dragon enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio and Lathliss.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing not to return anything to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
The Dragon token enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning the nontoken Dragon from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Dragon token, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1261-4407.description:
Activate Unbender Tine by tapping it, untap Time Vault.
Activate Time Vault by tapping it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

391-3201-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Blossom Dryad does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Blossom Dryad.
Arixmethes has at least one slumber counter on it.
391-3201-4222.description:
Activate Arixmethes by tapping it, adding {U}{G}.
Activate Blossom Dryad by tapping it, untapping Arixmethes.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Blossom Dryad.
Repeat any number of times.

391-3525-3573.notablePrerequisites:
Blossom Dryad does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Blossom Dryad.
You control at least two artifacts.
391-3525-3573.description:
Activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Blossom Dryad by tapping it, untapping Tolarian Academy.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Blossom Dryad.
Repeat any number of times.
